## Description

Runs the entity-level strategic-fit screen at the first gate — must-meet knock-out criteria plus a weighted should-meet scorecard — so no opportunity enters heavy analysis before passing a strategic filter. Produces per-item knock-out verdicts, the scored scorecard, a written rationale, and a deterministic go/hold/kill recommendation chip; the gate decision itself is recorded by a person. Use when: "strategic fit screen", "knock-out criteria", "hunt zone fit".
